tests.reason: Staging tests are read-only (rule 48): the two new POST routes are probed only as rejected writes (no token, no body -> 401 from requireAdminAuth before any handler). An ack or snooze is a write to the production database, so the write path, Zod validation, the P1-not-snoozable rule, the 24 h cap, the OASIS emit and the aggregator filtering are proven in CI with an in-memory store and a fake emitter; the migration is proven on a throwaway local Postgres (scripts/ci/sql-tests/run-ops-attention-acks-test.sh).
